run.decision: FAIL / NO_ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS. The exact current simplified-V11 high-return core raised full CAGR to 14.809181% versus V11 14.345615%, with Sharpe 1.523994 versus 1.522263 and MDD 7.771319% versus 7.689054%. It preserved 100% gross, nonnegative targets, no financing, and identical target fingerprints under 1.00% and 0.03% user fees. However, candidate Sharpe was at least V11 Sharpe in only 3/7 fixed folds, so deterministic admission failed. Paired 20,000-replicate 63-session bootstrap gave P(CAGR candidate > V11)=98.220% but P(Sharpe candidate > V11)=53.190%; median CAGR and Sharpe deltas were positive and candidate MDD P97.5=14.607% passed the 15% risk ceiling. Cumulative 43-candidate DSR=97.085% passed 95%. The evidence supports a higher-return research/aggressive-tier interpretation, not a robust all-around V11 replacement. Per the frozen stop rule, no blend-fraction, active-scale, band, C3/L3, LowNoise-profile, or other rescue tuning is permitted in this campaign.

methodology.follow_up_policy: This is a one-shot re-audit of an already exposed current component. After formal performance is opened, do not alter active scale, band, C3/L3 thresholds, LowNoise profile, stable-core blend fraction, costs, asset universe, start date, or add a second high-core-only variant. Failure closes this retrospective standalone-high-core campaign; success may support a separate aggressive product tier but does not retroactively make the old pre-protocol searches certified.
